gripOrHq.title: Private LDL Access
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Executive Wiretaps
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

heapOrArchives.title: Romp through HQ
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

heapOrArchives.title: HQ Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Toughonium™ Wall
ice.rulesText:
*End the run.
*End the run.
*End the run.
*End the run.

root.title: Crystal Palace Station Grid
root.rulesText:
Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to break each subroutine of each piece of ice encountered during runs on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Marionette
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner passes Marionette, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

ice.title: Datacomb
ice.rulesText: *End the run. If Runner passes Datacomb, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.

root.title: Corporate Shuffle
root.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Reclamation Project
root.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

root.title: Zombie
root.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Glacier
root.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
